TASVEG cross-reference dataset for development and testing

Source: R/data.R
TASVEG_xref.Rd

This is a test cross-reference of the TASVEG 5.0 classification to the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology, used for development and testing purposes. This table holds membership values assigned by four interpreters (anonymised using codenames) in a first round of interpretation. Column names have not been standardised, source ids (VEGCODE) and target ids (efg) include some errors (to test checks and validation).

Usage

TASVEG_xref

Format

A tibble with 4 columns:

VEGCODE

Original vegetation code of the source unit in the TASVEG 5.0 dataset, the source id being classified.

efg

Shortcode for the Ecosystem Functional Group (EFG) from the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology, the target id.

memb

Membership value between 0 and 1, indicating the degree of membership of the source vegetation or map unit to the target EFG.

interp

Character vector of codenames for interpreters who provided the membership value. Anonymous codenames used instead of real names or initials.

round

Numeric value for the round of interpretations. Currently only includes round 1.

Source

Mark Tozer (pers. comm.)

See also

Other data: IUCN_GET_LUT, TASVEG_LUT, TASVEG_mini, TASVEG_mini_expert_wide
